rationale: faultingThread=0 PC maps to partition_alloc::internal::OnNoMemoryInternal(unsigned long) at oom.cc:85 (Chromium PartitionAlloc). The trap path is V8::FatalProcessOutOfMemory -> v8::Utils::ReportOOMFailure -> (Electron)V8OOMErrorCallback -> partition_alloc::OnErrnoNoMem -> partition_alloc::OnNoMemory -> partition_alloc::OnNoMemoryInternal -> __builtin_trap (SIGTRAP). This is a deliberate, immediate OOM crash installed by Chromium (partition_alloc/oom.cc) and surfaced through V8's OOM reporting layer (api.cc). It is NOT a Node CHECK nor a third-party native addon.
